excerpt: Sembiam has residential and industrial plots side by side, so permitted use is the first check and orientation the key design decision. This guide covers both, plus lane access, plot documents and cost.
faqTitle: Building in Sembiam: questions owners ask

faqs.question: Do you have an office near Sembiam?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our branch office is in Sembiam, and our head office in Perambur and corporate office in Kolathur are nearby, so a site visit to a Sembiam plot is easy to arrange.

faqs.question: What do your house construction packages cost in Sembiam?
faqs.answer: Our packages are priced per sq ft of built-up area: Basic ₹2,199, Standard ₹2,399, Premium ₹2,699 and Ultra Luxury ₹3,199. Approvals, soil test, compound wall, sump and interiors are quoted separately. Where the lane is too tight for a transit mixer we add a named access line, and where an existing structure is coming down, demolition and debris disposal are listed separately.

faqs.question: Who approves building plans in Sembiam?
faqs.answer: For a typical individual house in Sembiam, the building permit comes from the Greater Chennai Corporation; larger buildings go to CMDA. Because uses are mixed here, confirm what your specific plot is permitted to carry before the drawings are prepared.

faqs.question: Which plot documents should I check in Sembiam?
faqs.answer: The patta and land classification, since the revenue record must support residential construction whatever the neighbours have built; the FMB sketch against the physical boundary, which often drifts on older mixed-use streets; and whether any service crosses the plot. We check all three before we price.

faqs.question: How do you set the plinth height in Sembiam?
faqs.answer: From how water has behaved on your lane in heavy rain, which long-time neighbours can tell you, not from the level of the house next door. We fix it before the foundation is designed.
